status: post-opening structure-preservation test frozen before endpoint readback
ecological_question: When recent rainfall expands the active species-by-site matrix by adding species and active sites, does the internal density of realized species-site associations change?
sample: same 4,236 matched wetter-drier route x seasonal-window pairs used by the RC6 metacommunity synthesis; exact-consecutive-year sensitivity prespecified

matrix_definition.rows: route-level acoustically active species in a run
matrix_definition.columns: acoustically active stops in that run
matrix_definition.incidence: species detected calling at a stop
matrix_definition.connectance: species-stop incidences / (route gamma richness * number of active stops), defined when gamma>=1 and active_stops>=1

primary_endpoint.name: delta_connectance
primary_endpoint.model: delta_connectance ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber)

equivalence_test.scale: absolute connectance units per one-unit rain_contrast
equivalence_test.rationale: Typical active-matrix connectance is near 0.5; a +/-0.05 slope corresponds to roughly a 10% relative change in matrix density per unit log-rainfall-recency contrast and is treated as the smallest change large enough to contradict structure-preserving expansion.
equivalence_test.method: 90% confidence interval / two one-sided tests at alpha=0.05
equivalence_test.support_rule: the entire 90% CI for the rain_contrast coefficient lies within [-0.05,+0.05]

secondary_descriptives: correlation of delta_connectance with delta_alpha_active and richness_gain
interpretation_if_equivalent: Rainfall-associated community expansion adds rows and columns without a material change in average fill of the active species-by-site matrix, consistent with approximately self-similar structure-preserving expansion.
interpretation_if_not_equivalent: Do not claim matrix-density preservation; retain the existing alpha-gamma-beta and boundary-expansion results without a self-similarity claim.
boundaries: Connectance is a property of the observed acoustic incidence matrix, not an interaction-network connectance measure.
Equivalence applies only to the prespecified +/-0.05 slope margin and does not prove exact invariance.
No occupancy, dispersal, colonization, extinction or rainfall-causality claim.
No alternative connectance transform, margin or subgroup may replace the frozen specification after readback.
